description: This file defines the class DeleteAlertDialogBuilder, which extends MaterialAlertDialogBuilder to create a custom alert dialog with branding applied to its buttons. The class manages dialog creation and applies specific styles to positive and negative buttons using the branding utility.

classes.name: DeleteAlertDialogBuilder
classes.description: A custom dialog builder that applies branding styles to dialog buttons, extending MaterialAlertDialogBuilder.

methods.name: DeleteAlertDialogBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dialog builder with context.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates the AlertDialog instance, applies branding, and sets up a listener to re-apply branding when the dialog is shown.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies styling to positive and negative buttons using branding utilities if they are instances of MaterialButton.
